integrity.computational_basis: Standalone Python standard-library checker with exact rational arithmetic at four parameter values.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic eigenvalue calculation and exact positive-gap identity.
unproved_limits: No classification of general nonreversible autocorrelation sequences is claimed.
No finite-sample estimator performance result is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The exact counterexample concerns a three-state lazy clockwise chain and one Fourier observable only.
It does not characterize all nonreversible chains or provide an optimal general lower bound.
The exact rational checks are finite consistency checks; the universal parameter claim is proved analytically.
title: A one-parameter counterexample to reversible two-lag variance bounds
